modules.name: decks
modules.whyItMatters: VC AiStack models decks as first-class venture work objects connected to diligence, memos, and research rather than isolated presentation files.
modules.instantDeckImplication: Generated deck versions should feel like reusable venture-work assets that can survive diligence review and follow-on workflows.

modules.name: diligence
modules.whyItMatters: Diligence surfaces expose questions, objections, and evidence gaps that should inform a founder-facing deck rewrite.
modules.instantDeckImplication: Instant Deck should strengthen weak claims and explicitly flag unsupported proof instead of hiding diligence risk.

modules.name: research
modules.whyItMatters: Research/source modules in VC AiStack treat source capture and backend-backed context as reusable system inputs.
modules.instantDeckImplication: Deck generation should preserve provenance-minded thinking and leave clear room for future research-backed enrichment.

modules.name: memos
modules.whyItMatters: Memo generation expects structured, concise, source-backed investor framing.
modules.instantDeckImplication: Slides should read like memo-grade investor reasoning compressed into presentation form.
